item.description:
[B] Comfy Pte. Ltd. — Singapore
Furniture is a high-ticket, highly personal purchase. When a customer’s custom dining table is delayed by logistics, or their new sofa arrives with a scuff mark, they get emotional. They get demanding. And yes, sometimes, they will raise their voice and scold you. We are looking for a Customer Service & Sales Support Specialist who has titanium-level thick skin. If you take customer complaints personally, this job will exhaust you. But if you have ice in your veins, high emotional intelligence, and the ability to disarm an angry, picky customer and turn them into a loyal brand advocate, you will absolutely thrive here. What You Will Do
• You will be the vital bridge between our sales team, our logistics/warehouse crew, and our clients. Your daily duties will include:
• Frontline Conflict Resolution: Field incoming calls and messages from demanding customers regarding delivery delays, defects, and post-purchase regrets.
• De-escalation: Handle high-tension interactions with empathy, strict professionalism, and authority, knowing how to calm a situation without giving away the house.
• Sales Support: Assist the sales team with processing orders, generating invoices, checking inventory, and following up on leads.
• Logistics Coordination: Liaise directly with the warehouse and delivery drivers to track orders, schedule replacements, and ensure promises made to the customer are kept.
• Quality Assurance Tracking: Log recurring product issues or delivery complaints so manage
